description: This source file defines a Spring MVC controller 'SecurityController' for handling user security and permissions within an admin interface of a web application. It contains request mappings for displaying permissions and groups, and a helper method for setting menu attributes in the model.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing user security and permissions in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayPermissions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display user permissions page, sets menu context.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display user group list, sets menu context, adds group list to model.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set active menu and current menu in model for navigation purposes.
